sonnet.problem: The opening card says "in view of His appearing and His kingdom". That hands over the answer to card 19, which asks the baker to fill in the blank with "appearing". The passage title and book name are the only exceptions, and this isn't one of them.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
